import platform, subprocess, importlib.metadata

def main():
    import lightgbm, numpy, pandas, qlib
    assert Path(qlib.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT)
    old = read(BASE/'docs/inputs-h20.json')

    models=read(BASE/'docs/sources-h20.json')['components']
    files += [ROOT/m['model']['path'] for m in models]
    env={'python':sys.version,'executable':sys.executable,'platform':platform.platform(),'machine':platform.machine(),'packages':sorted([{'name':d.metadata['Name'],'version':d.version} for d in importlib.metadata.distributions()],key=lambda v:v['name'].lower()),'thread_variables':{k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k in ['OMP_NUM_THREADS','OMP_DYNAMIC','OMP_SCHEDULE','MKL_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS','PYTHONHASHSEED']},'modules':{k:str(v.__file__) for k,v in [('lightgbm',lightgbm),('numpy',numpy),('pandas',pandas),('qlib',qlib)]},'lightgbm_binaries':[fingerprint(p) for p in Path(lightgbm.__file__).parent.rglob('*') if p.suffix in ['.so','.dylib']], 'git_head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),'git_diff':subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--','backtest/models/regime_adapt.py','backtest/scripts/train/train_regime_arm.py','qlib/contrib/model/gbdt.py'],cwd=ROOT,text=True)}
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-environment.json',env)
    files += [BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-environment.json']
    plan={'schema_version':1,'kind':'supplementary_training_stability','parent_exp_id':'training-target/horizon-style-p50-20261105-v1','parent_closed_campaign':'horizon-style-p50-20261105-v1','user_authorization':'先查两轮patience50训练稳定性；若无法定位原因，再用两模型真阶梯比较gap。','prior_cumulative_model_fits':103,'temporary_directory':str(TMP),'seeds':[42,1000,2000,3000,4000], 'initial_jobs':[{'label':label,'seed':3000,'repeat':rep,'mode':'original'} for rep in [1,2] for label in ['old','new']], 'hypotheses':['Exact same inputs and process settings reproduce each label treatment.','Only the 106 normalized H20 label changes reproduce the old/new training trajectory divergence.'], 'fixed':{'recipe':read(BASE/'configs/frozen-study.json')['parameters'],'es_metric':'top5_h5_net_ann','valid_cutoff':'2026-07-23','feature_snapshot':'2026-11-02','old_training_labels':'frozen Nov2 cache','new_training_labels':'frozen Nov3 cache','evaluation_snapshot':'2026-11-03','evaluation_mode':'historical_selection_window'}, 'decision_rules':['First compare exact ordered feature/label/weight/validation signatures before any fit.','Four separate-process original-setting fits: old/new labels twice each, seed3000, original 8 threads; no new determinism parameter initially.','Record every round metric plus tree hashes and full validation prediction signatures; equality of scores alone is insufficient.','If identical-input results differ, use up to four predeclared diagnostic fits (old/new x two repeats) with deterministic=True and force_col_wise=True, leaving num_threads=8. Treat this as a diagnostic change, never historical reproduction.','If old seed3000 returns the historical trajectory, recover remaining four old-label seeds once each to reconstruct the old ensemble; do not select repeats by higher return.','If causal source remains unresolved, run existing top3/h5 true ladder for both five-seed treatments. Recompute fixed-s5 for reconstructed old signal and verify against historical30.54%; new s5 is a frozen reference. Do not call a reconstructed old model an exact historical model unless its stored predictions are verified against preserved hashes/numerics.','Report CAGR gap and arithmetic-account gap separately; model Top3H5 arithmetic annualization and account CAGR are different metrics. No strategy grid/promotion/production change.'], 'budget':{'max_model_fits':12,'max_wall_hours':8,'max_account_jobs':4,'concurrency':1,'initial_fits':4,'conditional_old_ensemble_fits':4,'conditional_determinism_fits':4}, 'retention':'One existing platform entry; retained main H7/H15/H20 untouched. Keep compact exact model/curve/prediction evidence needed for this causal comparison within H20; remove duplicate repetitions and temporary matrices after numerical comparison and audit. Preserve adapter source text and package/source fingerprints in audit JSON before deleting executables.', 'harness_capability_boundary':'Formal inspect_state confirms closed parent and prior cost103. Native initialize hardcodes one configs/harness-plan.json and docs/harness-state.json per archive; it cannot append a new phase to this closed one-entry experiment without overwriting or adding a new entity. The explicitly bounded supplemental ledger records all fits and frozen identities; no native lifecycle-success claim and no parent reopening.', 'frozen_files':[fingerprint(p) for p in files]}
    assert not PLAN.exists() and not STATE.exists()
    write(PLAN,plan)
    write(STATE,{'status':'active','started_at':time.time(),'deadline':time.time()+8*3600,'plan':fingerprint(PLAN),'prior_cumulative_model_fits':103,'model_fits_started':0,'jobs':[],'phase':'stability','account_jobs':[]})
    for p in [TMP/'common.py',TMP/'setup.py',TMP/'fit.py']:register_adapter(p)
    print(json.dumps({'plan':str(PLAN),'state':str(STATE),'budget':plan['budget']}))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
